requirements.definition: When the internal file is an allocatable deferred-length character scalar variable, writing assigns the characters by intrinsic assignment, allocating or reallocating to length equal to the number of characters written if necessary.

pending.deferred-length-internal-write-reallocat: Allocate with a different length and sentinel contents, write a distinct shorter/longer record, and assert LEN equals the new written count and old sentinels are gone.

accounting.rationale: Defines internal files as internal-storage transfer/conversion media.
The property list mixes definitions, requirements, permissions, and restrictions and is split into fine units.
Defines the permitted character-kind variable basis for internal files.
Vector-subscript array-section exclusion for internal files.
Defines scalar internal-file record count and length.
Defines array internal-file records, order, and lengths.
Blank-fill effect for short non-deferred internal records.
Length overrun prohibition for non-deferred internal records.
Permission/capability for definition or undefinition by means other than output.
Default pre-transfer positioning and current record effect, with child-transfer exception.
Defines internal-file initial connection-mode values by OPEN defaults.
CLOSE/INQUIRE/OPEN unit prohibition for internal files.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 12 file position, file storage units and internal files (batch146). Every unit hash-verified against the pinned census and read through page 249 by an independent reviewer, accepted with no findings. Mixed obligation/latitude splits at 12.3.4.2 p2, 12.3.4.3 p2 and p3, 12.3.4.4 p1, 12.3.5 p2 and p4 and across the fifteen fine units of 12.4 p2 were verified and none was missed; 12.3.4.1's all-definition classification loses no obligation; the octet recommendation is a recommendation.
